verification_note: new() auto-populates field defaults resolved root-to-leaf up the inheritance chain: a child class's own default for a field name OVERRIDES the parent's (Person.legs=2 wins over Animal.legs=4); a field the child doesn't redeclare is still inherited from the parent (Person.sound=
from Animal); an instance of the PARENT class itself still gets the parent's own defaults, unaffected by the child's overrides (Animal instance: legs=4)
